key_findings: Injectable glycol chitosan/oxidized hyaluronic acid hydrogel releases dexamethasone and mepivacaine for >72 h and prolongs anti-inflammatory effect in LPS-activated macrophages.
In CCI rats the gel reduced cold and mechanical allodynia and lowered Trpv1, Trpa1 and Cgrp expression at 14 DPI.
